notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025684/a10482f9c7894591aff74b092acdf925366c4ffe.png

A new system of decorations and amulets has been added to the game.

Main changes:
🔸Now amulets and decorations affect categories of items, for example: increasing the chance of finding backyard activators
🔸Changed item descriptions: now they are shorter and clearer
🔸Significantly increased the power of the effect
🔸The duration of the effect and the cost of decors and amulets have been revised
🔸Added decorations for copper coins in the main categories
🔸Amulet parts are now assembled from 20 parts, regardless of the amulet
🔸Old amulets will remain unchanged, they are marked in the inventory as “Old”, they can be used in the same way as new ones, but identical items, for example, “Old Goose Feather” and “Goose Feather” cannot be activated at the same time.

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025684/a10482f9c7894591aff74b092acdf925366c4ffe.png

There are big changes in the mansion. The changes affected everyone.

🔸Now you can choose the mode of passing the room. It can be changed at any time for gold coins. But some modes will also require special items that can be found in the shop. 

🔸The item search function has also been changed. When you turn on the search, your chances of finding an item increases significantly. The rarer the item, the greater the multiplier. But after you find it, you need to wait for the next activation. The duration of the wait also depends on the rarity of the item. 

🔸In addition, the puppeteer announces a 50% sale on items from the collection. The sale will last 3 days.📎

notes.title: Global update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025684/04d2e4d17e7a08f6e1fcb2a40cb92b96aeaa4b24.png

It seems that the life of the puppets has frozen in place, but at the same time, a large reconstruction is taking place in the mansion. In some places, holes have been patched up and cracks have been patched up, and some things will be completely new to the inhabitants. All this is part of a big technical update.

Thanks to this update, you will soon find new challenges and continuation of the story, but for now it's time to get used to the new rules of the Puppeteer game.

🔑First of all, collection recipes have been changed, but the rewards for them have also changed and become more fair.
🔑Secondly, the objects of association no longer appear from nowhere, they will have to be searched in the rooms or asked from a friend, but the friend will have to give what he found with his work.
🔑Thirdly, the Puppeteer hid almost all things, they can be found in other places, and some items appeared for the first time.

Get used to the new rules and remember that this is only the beginning of a new story...
